title: Florissant strikes an emotional chord with a debut of raw reflection “Sort It Out”
htmlContent:
Florissant’s “Sort It Out” is a deeply poignant reflection on watching a loved one spiral into self destruction, the single pulls at the heartstrings with its provocative lyricism.

“Sort It Out” is both a debut and a declaration, showcasing a voice that carries both vulnerability and power. The performance is raw yet controlled, weaving through melancholic tones and crescendos that mirror the emotional turbulence of the lyrics.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6xmbYQceghPWhNpdtrVQtD?si=s2PEC73_S1u_DY8hA6qMJw

The production allows each element to breathe, giving space for the emotion to settle in. There’s an almost cinematic quality to how the music builds, drawing the listener deeper into the narrative of helplessness and longing. “Sort It Out” sets the bar high. Florissant is gearing up for a run that will keep listeners captivated and emotionally invested.
